trigger: A metric-required field has no exact two-of-three majority after three complete first-round blind files.
selection: Select item IDs from blind queue and first-round field votes only. Do not read or join the method/source audit during selection or re-review.

procedure.task_inputs: Same frozen gold, role definitions, node name, highlighted preview, and anonymous within-asset node list as round one.
procedure.locked_fields: All fields that reached first-round consensus, including name verdict, required matched role, geometry-real flag, and same-part relation, are immutable.
procedure.replacement: For each triggered field, use an exact two-of-three majority of independent round-two votes. Do not mix one first-round vote with round-two votes.
procedure.failure_policy: If a triggered field still has no round-two majority, the dependent formal metric remains null and the unresolved count is reported.

geometry_role_clarification: Choose the most specific frozen required or optional role supported by geometry and placement.
Use other_real_part:<short_snake_case_label> only for a coherent role absent from the frozen ontology.
Use unknown only when the highlighted preview cannot support a defensible physical role.
instance_clarification: Compare all nodes in the anonymous asset that share the physical role.
Use a stable qualifier or ordinal only when it is actually conveyed by the node name.
Use ambiguous for repeated physical-role instances whose names do not distinguish them.
Use not_applicable only when the physical role is a singleton in that asset.
disclosure: This is a blind field-only re-review for annotation completeness, not an independent fourth judge and not a change to any first-round semantic verdict.
